title: Where Does Advertising Content Lead You? We Created a Bookstore to Find Out
eligible_reason: Randomized experiment in a simulated online bookstore (display-ad content conditions); consumer-level OLS of search and purchase outcomes on randomized ad-condition dummies with demographics. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: 6_analyze_ad_effects.do: reg outcome ad_plain ad_genre ad_price demographics, robust (and treatment vs control by genre group); 7_visualize_results.do: position/rank regressions; 5_analyze_randomization_checks.do: balance.
data_files_note: Full experimental data shipped (Qualtrics with hashed identifiers, Google Analytics logs, WooCommerce orders); only the Comscore data for Appendix Figure A5 are withheld.
data_provenance_note: Authors' own experimental data, identifiers hashed.
software_notes: Stata 17 plus R 4.2.2 for bar charts.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
